slides.headline: SHE POSTED 'GOING TO BED' AT 5:35 AM. SHE WASN'T.

caption:
A VC posted 'Going to bed these days' at 5:35 in the morning. She was not going to bed. 🌙

On September 29 at 5:35 AM, venture capitalist Justine Moore posted four words on X: 'Going to bed these days.' She was not going to bed. The post got 240,000 engagements. The person paid to bet on the future could not sleep.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: X (venturetwins)

#AI #Tech #StartupLife #VentureCapital #SiliconValley
